en: A vintage written postcard or official card with handwritten text in Estonian, addressed to the head of Pürksalu (Pürksalu/Pürtsalu) primary school. It contains a short message about an error by a print shop, an apology, and a request to deduct one kroon from an account. At the bottom left is the place and date "Narva 22.XII.29" and on the right a handwritten signature with a purple stamped name "M. N. Minis". The card has no visible photograph or decorative image, just text.
